title: fix(gates): Check Changeset route 2 and check-empty-changeset stop listing skills/** as releasing nothing
body:
Fixes #23451

Clause-②: no

## What

`@objectstack/skills` publishes `skills/**`. Its build (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`) copies every regular file under `skills/` into `dist/skills/`, with no exclusions. Its `files` field is `["dist", "README.md", "CHANGELOG.md"]`, and it is in the changeset `fixed` group. Two gate texts still told an author that a `skills/**` change releases nothing and should take `skip-changeset`. That disagrees with AGENTS.md's post-task checklist (`AGENTS.md:1085` at `2d2e3ce43`), which reserves the label for "a diff that publishes nothing from any released package".

This PR changes only text: prose, comments, one `::error::` line, and one self-test battery's name and rationale. **Neither gate passes or refuses anything it did not pass or refuse before.** The `Check Changeset` verdict step has no path branch, and `check-empty-changeset.mjs` reads only `.changeset/*.md` rows. Neither has a `skills/**` case to change.

## Site by site (line numbers at base `2d2e3ce43`)

| Site | Verdict | Change |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs:513`, printed remedy "It releases nothing (.github/, .claude/, skills/, …" | FALSE | `skills/` is dropped from the list. The "It releases something" bullet now says a `skills/**` change does, because it ships in `@objectstack/skills`. |
| same file `:913-916`, GREEN 3 comment and `battery()` name ("Such a PR takes the `skip-changeset` label", "(route 2)") | FALSE | The battery is renamed to `GREEN 3: a skills/**-only PR carrying NO changeset: nothing to judge`. The comment now says why this gate stays silent: it reads only the `.changeset/*.md` rows a diff touches. It also says the PR still owes a changeset naming `@objectstack/skills`. Asking for that changeset is the `Require a changeset` step's job, and catching a wrong label is review's job. |
| same file `:679`, roster row | follows the rename | Renamed together with the `battery()` call. The floor keys on the name (see the ablation below). |
| same file `:921-922`, GREEN 3 assertion messages ("must be green here", "must not even be read") | TRUE | unchanged |
| same file `:67`, header narrative of the `skills/**` precedent chain (#4607 / #5130 / #5451, then PR #5799) | TRUE, as history | unchanged |
| same file `:866-872`, RED 1 (the #5799 shape: a `skills/**` change plus a new empty changeset) | TRUE: still refused, still the gate's own case | unchanged |
| `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml:795`, route 2's "releases nothing" list | FALSE | `skills/` dropped |
| same file `:812-820`, route 2's `skills/**` paragraph ("skills/ ships with no npm package … That premise is true … Take the label.") | FALSE | Rewritten. `skills/**` is not on the list, because it ships in `@objectstack/skills`. A `skills/**` change takes route 1, naming that package, and never takes the label. The old premise no longer holds. |
| same file `:842`, `::error::` line ("including any 'skills/**' change -- see #5947") | FALSE | The parenthetical now says a `skills/**` change releases `@objectstack/skills` and never takes the label. The line still opens with `::error::This PR adds no changeset.`, which `check-changeset-no-major.mjs` pins. |
| same file `:846-852`, step comment on the same precedent chain | TRUE, as history | unchanged |

No new tracker number enters any text an author is shown.

## Verification (head `7463fab7c`)

- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --self-test` exited 0: `✓ check-empty-changeset --self-test: 170 assertions over real temp git repos (real scan() path)`.
- Ablation (run once, no file kept). The fix is committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` then put the `battery()` call back to the old `(route 2)` name, leaving the roster at the new name. The self-test exited 1 with: `battery "GREEN 3: … (route 2)" registered 2 case(s) but is not declared in SELF_TEST_BATTERIES` and `battery "GREEN 3: … nothing to judge" DID NOT RUN — 0 cases registered, 2 pinned`. The tool restored the file: blob after restore `c0df1afc9232` equals HEAD's, and `git diff HEAD` is empty. `git status --porcelain` read 0 lines afterwards.
- The consumer battery requires the `::error::This PR adds no changeset` line to reach `exit 1` within 900 characters. It measures 730 after the edit (698 before). The workflow parses with `yaml` 2.9.1, and the `Require a changeset` step is found.
- Gates, derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against merge base `2d2e3ce43`: 53 commands, and every one exited 0. These include `check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:workflow-status-functions`, `check:workflow-step-name-quoting`, `check-self-test-workflow-commands.mjs`, `check:nul-bytes` and `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (fast tier, 1841 cases). Reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 53 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED`.
- Lint, narrowed to the touched files. `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` returned 2 results: `scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs` with 0 errors and 0 warnings, and `pr-automation.yml` "ignored because no matching configuration was supplied". So the YAML is outside eslint's own population. `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (zero `parserOptions.project`, as stated at its line 327), so this diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- NOT MEASURED, and left to CI per the derivation: 7 families valued from the workflow, the `Test Core` job's own steps, and 4 type-check lanes. This diff touches no TypeScript.

## Acceptance notes

- The card cites `AGENTS.md:1085`. That line states the general rule, "A bug fix in a released package takes a **`patch`** changeset — never none, and ⛔ never `skip-changeset`: that label is for a diff that publishes nothing from any released package". It names no `skills/**` case. The skills case follows from the packaging fact above. So the new texts say "a changeset naming `@objectstack/skills`" and fix no bump level: route 1's level rules apply.
- The card title says "so it passes with no changeset". Measured on base: the `Require a changeset` step reds any PR that adds no changeset and lacks the label, `skills/**` or not. A `skills/**`-only PR passed only through the label that route 2 told its author to apply, and that instruction is what this PR corrects.
- Not added: refusing a `skills/**` diff that carries no changeset. That would be new gate behaviour, and triage left it for the maintainer's word (「新增门禁默认否」).
- Unchanged and only noted: route 2's closing tie-break, "If you are unsure between routes 1 and 2, take route 2". It is general guidance and not about `skills/**`.
- Changeset: none; this PR takes `skip-changeset`. Root `scripts/` and `.github/workflows/` ship in no package. Across 72 non-private `package.json` files, no `files` entry leaves its own package directory. `git grep` for either file name under `packages/` (CHANGELOGs excluded) has zero hits, against a control (`sync-catalog`) that hits.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:改两处提示文字,内容是"要不要写 changeset"。一处是 `Check Changeset` 的路线 2(在 `pr-automation.yml`),另一处是 `check-empty-changeset.mjs` 的修复提示。两处原来都说"只改 `skills/**` 不发布任何包,贴 `skip-changeset` 标签即可"。现在改成:改 `skills/**` 会随 `@objectstack/skills` 一起发布,要写 changeset 并点名这个包,不贴标签。另外,一个自测用例改了名字,注释也重写了。

**为什么改**:`@objectstack/skills` 上线后,`skills/**` 已经随 npm 包发布,旧提示和 AGENTS.md 的发布清单相互矛盾。已经出过一次真实问题:PR #23443 照旧提示贴了标签,这次改动差点进不了 CHANGELOG,到合同复核才被发现。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:只改文字和注释。两道门禁放行什么、拒绝什么都没有变,自测 170 条断言全部通过。代价是旧提示里那段早期 skills PR 的历史说明删短了。如需回滚,还原这一个 commit 即可。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:审阅后在本 PR 上给出批准(本 PR 改到 `.github/workflows/**`,属于 Tier H)。
